categories.name: Data Selection
why_advanced: Dataset mixes structured metadata and unstructured text at scale (53,187 rows).
Quality burden includes structural missingness, heavy-tailed engagement, and temporal normalization challenges.
Real-world social-media noise requires both text and tabular preprocessing policies.

categories.name: Data Exploration
why_advanced: EDA includes extensive visual diagnostics across distributions, temporal patterns, and post types.
Statistical diagnostics include Spearman association, Kruskal-Wallis group test, and anomaly-rate quantification.
Interpretation and caveats are explicitly documented with effect-size context.

categories.name: Data Pre-processing
why_advanced: Policy decisions explicitly cover missingness, duplicates, outliers, type correction, transformations, scaling, and encoding.
Quality handling is deterministic and reproducible via code plus JSON diagnostics.
Data quality issues are addressed comprehensively without representativeness-damaging row drops.

categories.name: Feature Engineering
why_advanced: Feature set extends baseline variables with sentiment and topic-model signals.
Deterministic ablation quantifies incremental utility (baseline vs +sentiment vs +topics).
Model diagnostics include ROC/PR/confusion and explicit tradeoff/limitation discussion.

categories.name: Written Report
why_advanced: Report follows exact required assignment order and contains all mandatory sections.
Major claims are linked to figure and JSON artifacts through a dedicated traceability table.
Methods, findings, limitations, and future recommendations are articulated with quantitative backing.
